_note: Operator reference data. Trade-body membership changes; the rejection letter always names the correct appeal route (POPLA for BPA operators, IAS for IPC operators), so this file is for context and drafting hints only. Edit freely — no code changes needed.

operators.name: ParkingEye Ltd
operators.siteType: ANPR camera, retail and motorway services
themes: Cases usually rest entirely on ANPR entry and exit stills, so ask for full-colour images and the second-by-second timestamps.
Check the Notice to Keeper against the 14-day POFA limit — pure ANPR cases have no windscreen ticket to extend it.
Maximum-stay sites often turn on whether the consideration period was enough to read the terms and park.

operators.name: Euro Car Parks
operators.siteType: Retail, leisure and town-centre car parks
themes: Signage at the entrance is frequently the decisive point — request the site plan and dated photographs.
Confirm whether the charge was issued on the basis of a windscreen ticket or ANPR, as the POFA deadline differs.
Landowner authority is worth requesting where the site changed management.

operators.name: UK Parking Control Ltd
themes: Often a windscreen ticket followed by a postal notice, so the 28-to-56-day POFA window applies, not the 14-day one.
Residential sites frequently turn on whether the keeper was ever shown the terms in the tenancy or lease.
Request the landowner contract where the operator's authority is not obvious.

operators.name: NCP (National Car Parks)
operators.siteType: Pay-and-display, station and town-centre car parks
themes: Failure to display or a faulty machine is worth documenting with a timestamped photograph.
Check whether a valid ticket was purchased but misread — payment records can be requested.
Grace periods after paid time expires are commonly the winning point.

operators.name: Smart Parking Ltd
themes: ANPR-only evidence: presence at the cameras is not automatically a period of parking.
A second visit on the same day is a common cause of an apparently excessive recorded stay.
Ask for the full evidence pack before you accept the recorded duration.

operators.name: Excel Parking Services Ltd
themes: IPC operators must offer the Independent Appeals Service (IAS) rather than POPLA — check the wording on the rejection.
Payment-machine faults and unclear tariff boards are common grounds.
Request the signage schedule and the machine maintenance log for the date in question.

operators.name: MET Parking Services Ltd
themes: Airport and hotel sites often hinge on the exact terms shown at entry.
Check the period of parking stated on the notice against the timestamps you are given.
Consider whether the charge is a genuine estimate of loss or a penalty, given ParkingEye v Beavis.

operators.name: Civil Enforcement Ltd
themes: Confirm the land is 'relevant land' for POFA purposes — not all sites qualify.
Check the prescribed POFA wording is present in full on the Notice to Keeper.
Request proof of the operator's authority to issue charges in its own name.

operators.name: Horizon Parking
themes: Healthcare and education sites often have permit schemes with unclear signage.
Request the evidence that the permit terms were brought to the driver's attention.
Check the notice date against the 14-day POFA window where no windscreen ticket was issued.

operators.name: APCOA Parking UK
themes: Station and airport sites are usually byelaw or contractual — check which basis the notice states.
Drop-off zones rely on very short periods; request the exact entry and exit timestamps.
Ask for the contractual terms incorporated at the point of entry.
